package channelactivation

import (
    "context"
    "testing"
    "time"
)

// Offline reproducer of the agent -> activation replacement -> MCP discovery
// wait cycle. The production callers acquire these leases in separate contexts.
func TestAgentGChannelPresentationNestedAcquireProbe(t *testing.T) {
    publication := testEmptyPublication(t)
    owner, err := NewOwner(publication)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    held, err := owner.AcquirePresentationContext(context.Background())
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    replaced := make(chan error, 1)
    go func() { replaced <- owner.Replace(publication) }()
    defer func() {
        held.Release()
        if err := <-replaced; err != nil { t.Error(err) }
    }()
    deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
    for {
        owner.mu.Lock()
        fenced := !owner.accepting
        owner.mu.Unlock()
        if fenced { break }
        if time.Now().After(deadline) { t.Fatal("replacement did not fence") }
        time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
    }
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
    defer cancel()
    nested, err := owner.AcquirePresentationContext(ctx)
    if err != nil {
        t.Fatalf("MCP discovery cannot acquire while its provider holds the predecessor and replacement waits for that provider: %v", err)
    }
    nested.Release()
}
